verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs list Incoming Webhooks as a way to post messages from apps into Teams, and describe webhooks and connectors as linking web services to channels and teams [ms-teams-docs-36, ms-teams-docs-44, ms-teams-docs-10]. One older community complaint says integrations need the full Azure/Graph stack unlike Slack's simple webhooks [ms-teams-comm-11], but it is general criticism rather than a reported failure of Incoming Webhooks, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: detail showing the setup is a simple per-channel URL with a plain HTTP POST, payload/format documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
